notes: Cleans both tables: imputes missing parrainage values, computes AGE via INTCK, parses the French dd-mois-yy date format via SCAN + SELECT/WHEN into a numeric DATE_COMMANDE, and filters out negative amounts. autoexec.sas preloads ~25 clients and ~80 commandes from the real data. Dates arrive as strings (CSV origin) and are converted via INPUT(..., DDMMYY10.).
